about: OneGrasp Stress & Resilience Check for working professionals (0-5, 5-15, 15+ years). Workplace pressures are measured in four areas - workload, toxic behaviour, culture & relationships, career & job security - in OneGrasp's own wording. Burnout uses the Copenhagen Burnout Inventory (Kristensen et al., 2005), personal and work-related scales, word for word and without a time frame, as published. Coping uses eight scales of the Brief COPE (Carver, 1997), word for word, with the time frame set to the last 4 weeks as the author allows. Every answer is scored 0-100. Item ids are stable - results store answers by id, so never reuse an id for a different question.

items.text: I had more tasks than I could realistically finish.
